exposure: Number of children planned for the future
Perceived risk of caesarean-related side effects
outcome: Planned mode of delivery (cesarean or vaginal birth)
cohort: 470 pregnant women in Bandar Abbas city, Iran.
finding: Maternal characteristics, obstetric variables, childbirth knowledge, maternal self-efficacy, and perceived risk of cesarean-related side effects influenced women's decisions regarding planned mode of delivery.
